note: Written BEFORE any candidate model was trained or scored. A candidate ships only on a clean sweep of all 9 gates. Partial passes are a reported negative result, not a ship.

gates.name: TSPLIB EUC_2D dispersion vs Asymptotic_MST
gates.rule: sd_ratio significantly < 1 vs Asymptotic_MST, Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, same family the frozen model was judged in (ood_harness.dispersion_verdict default baseline family, one candidate per call)

gates.name: TSPLIB EUC_2D mean gain vs Calibrated_MST_dn
gates.rule: mean APE gain vs Calibrated_MST_dn remains significant, Holm p < 0.05, family = ood_harness.evaluate_candidate comparison family (all strata x all baselines), same as the frozen model

gates.name: Monotonicity probe
gates.slice: 1000 ND-test instances, seed 42, 24-point log grids: d in [2,200], n in [5,4000]
gates.rule: >= 99% non-increasing on BOTH swept axes AND no violation exceeding 1e-3 (deployed alpha scale)

gates.name: Extraction cost
gates.rule: candidate feature-extraction time / frozen feature-extraction time <= 1.35, measured back-to-back inside ONE process, interleaved, no absolute wall-clock reported

gates.name: LineNoise alpha slope
gates.rule: OLS slope of predicted alpha on true alpha >= 0.70

gates.name: No 2D class regression
gates.rule: no group regresses more than 0.15 MAPE vs the frozen GART 2.0 production row

gates.name: TSPLIB non-Euclidean screened
gates.rule: no MAPE regression vs frozen AND coverage must not drop

additional_directional_requirement_from_.rule: A shippable arm must beat 2D overall MAPE 2.9042 while holding ND at or under 0.6401. Failing that is a genuine negative result and is to be reported as one.

adversarial_checks_pre_registered.name: augmentation-vs-benchmark leakage
adversarial_checks_pre_registered.test: zero name overlap (verified independently) plus nearest-neighbour distance in standardised feature space from every benchmark line_noise/grid instance to the nearest augmentation instance, compared against the benchmark's own within-family NN distance distribution. Near-duplicates sink the result.

adversarial_checks_pre_registered.name: one-constant recalibration control
adversarial_checks_pre_registered.test: frozen model multiplied by a single constant fitted on the LineNoise family (in-sample, the most generous possible version of the control). The winning arm's LineNoise gain must clearly exceed what that one constant buys.

arms: A = 31 frozen features + augmentation in TRAIN only
B = 34 features (frozen + mst_topology_straightness + degeneracy_pca_effective_rank + mst_topology_deg2_straight_mean) + augmentation in TRAIN only
reporting.preference: Arm A strongly preferred if it clears the gates (zero inference cost increase). A is tested and reported first regardless of which is better.
